---
title: "5.4.2. Filter the data"
other-links:
  - text: "Version française"
    href: ../fr/5-4-2-filtrer-les-donnees.qmd
    icon: translate
---

The “Filter” section you to select data sets within the table by:

1.  Type of data (vectors, rasters, or tables or lists). Just check the corresponding radio button in the "Filter" section.
2.  A piece of text stored in any of the fields included in the table. Just enter the text in question in the "Text (any field, case sensitive)" field.
3.  Specific tag(s) by entering them in the "Tags filter" field.
4.  Any combination of the above (i.e., data type, text, or tags).

 The results of the filtering will appear in the "Available data" table located in the module panel.
